Deb

messages.author: bbc57ffa8a14ad13
messages.subject: Re: To install ShinyDash on Windows XP
parts:
Hi Deb,

shiny 0.6.0 is the most recent version we have on CRAN, but we develop shiny on GitHub, so you can always get the latest version here: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny

The easiest way to install the latest version of Shiny is to use the devtools package:

# install.packages("devtools") #(if you don't already have it installed)
library(devtools)
install_github("shiny", "rstudio')

At that point, you should be able to get shinyDash to install and run.

Jeff
